name: Green Juice
siboNotes: Start with small servings as concentrated vegetable juices can trigger symptoms. Avoid if contains apple, pear, or high amounts of celery.
preparationTips: Choose juices made primarily from low-FODMAP vegetables like spinach, kale, cucumber
Avoid green juices containing apple, pear, celery in large amounts, or wheat grass
Check ingredients list carefully - many commercial green juices contain high-FODMAP fruits
Consider diluting with water to reduce FODMAP concentration
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamins A, C, and K
